Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Keep its vehicle design, all armor/body panels, tires, wheel positions, roof and fins, color, camera angle, position, scale and framing exactly unchanged. Keep the dark showroom architecture and circular reflective platform. It is essential that this remains the same car in the same low front three-quarter view, nose at lower left. Do not redesign or simplify the car. Image 2 is ONLY an aura / air-flow visual-effect quality reference; do not copy its vehicle, manufacturer logo, architecture or different facing direction.

USER REQUEST: add clearly visible high-quality effects AROUND the entire vehicle, not just extra headlight or wheel LEDs. Make a finished collectible high-tier vehicle key-art illustration. Add graceful energetic aero ribbons flowing from the front splitter, sweeping around the outside of the wheels and along the vehicle's sides, then arching behind the roof and rear fins. Two to three separated translucent flow paths should visibly surround the silhouette in depth, with small luminous particle trails and low swirling vapor behind the car. Give the effect a bright narrow core with a soft transparent falloff. Broad graceful movement, not a mass of random jagged bolts. Include appropriate colored reflections on the existing floor and mild local rim light on the existing body.
The effect must be prominent enough to immediately read as an aura in a small inventory thumbnail, comparable in visual importance to image 2, while every original vehicle feature remains readable. Put most bright energy OUTSIDE the body silhouette; do not paint luminous paths across the hood, windshield or wheel details. Do not turn the car into a transparent energy shell, recolor its body, add another vehicle, create a spherical shield, add giant symbols/magic circles or cloak it in opaque smoke. No text, logo, rank, label, signature, watermark or UI. Preserve the complete original car and the full opaque showroom background.
Specific effect palette and character: powerful COLD WHITE / SILVER airflow with delicate ice-blue edges, a frost-like metallic starlight aura around the black armored car. Multiple clean pale aerodynamic arcs sweep alongside the front and rear wheels; a soft silver-white stream rises behind the rear fins. Fine cool-white particles and reflective glints. The car's paint remains the same dark black gunmetal. White aura should have clear luminous edges rather than look like ordinary smoke.

Input image 3 is ONLY the GOLDEN AURA / AERODYNAMIC EFFECT QUALITY reference.

Re-create the orange vehicle in image 1 as a finished game vehicle artwork in the exact presentation family of image 2. Preserve its distinctive saturated racing-orange main body and separate raised front wheel pods, long orange central wedge nose, large open black-carbon aerodynamic channels between nose and front wheel pods, dark teardrop canopy, narrow white/cool-cyan Y-like light strips along the outer front edges, exposed suspension details, slim upper roof intake/fin, very low black carbon splitter and big rear wing.
